apps.name: Alan
apps.summary: Highlight the active Mac window with a border, or dim everything around it.
apps.description: A fork of tylerhall/Alan with border styles, per-app colours, a window-finding hotkey and spotlight dimming. Requires macOS 15.7 or later.

screenshots.alt: Alan highlighting the active Mac window

apps.name: Asterinked
apps.summary: Annotate PDFs with a pressure-sensitive stylus on Android.
apps.description: Write, highlight and erase ink, then export an annotated PDF with vector strokes and selectable original text. Drafts stay on-device. Requires Android 10 or later.

apps.name: Baegun
apps.summary: Convert PDF and CBZ books to EPUB from a desktop app or command line.
apps.description: PDF conversion uses Mistral OCR to recover text, tables and images. CBZ conversion runs locally and creates fixed-layout EPUBs. The desktop and command-line tools share the conversion engine.

apps.name: 帮你Draw
apps.summary: Layered drawing and painting with pressure-sensitive pens and pigment colour mixing.
apps.description: Sketch with pencils and brushes, mix colours, smudge, fill, and work with layers. Built for Android and the S Pen, with desktop shells for macOS and Linux.

apps.name: Blipbird
apps.summary: Track flights, gates, routes and itinerary changes on Android.
apps.description: A departure board, live route map, daylight and weather ribbon, and flight-change notifications. Itineraries remain available offline; flight data uses free or bring-your-own-key providers.

screenshots.alt: Blipbird flight board, route map and itinerary screens

apps.name: BootCaptain
apps.summary: Audit Mac startup items and investigate failed launches.
apps.description: Inventories launch agents, login items and other startup mechanisms, attributes them to installed products, and investigates boot failures. Includes a SwiftUI app and a command-line tool.
apps.maturityNote: A research prototype, not a supported release.

apps.name: DockVac
apps.summary: Inspect Docker disk usage as a treemap and remove selected items.
apps.description: Shows images, containers, volumes and build cache by size. Review a cleanup plan with the corresponding Docker commands before removing individual items. Requires macOS 13 or later and a local Docker daemon.

screenshots.alt: DockVac treemap of Docker disk usage

apps.name: Eko
apps.summary: Forward Android notifications and verification codes to your Mac over local Wi-Fi.
apps.description: A Mac menu-bar app and paired Android companion forward notifications over an authenticated local connection. Missed notifications are queued on the phone and replayed when the Mac reconnects.

apps.name: Gans
apps.summary: Access Ente Auth verification codes from a Mac menu bar or Linux tray.
apps.description: Search accounts with a global hotkey and copy or type their current codes. Synchronizes with Ente Auth using its end-to-end encryption. A Linux port is available in the source tree.

apps.name: Invoque
apps.summary: Launch apps, find files and run custom commands from a keyboard-first Mac panel.
apps.description: A launcher with calculation, file search and plain-file custom commands. Its built-in make command can generate and refine new commands with a configured language model. Requires macOS 13 or later.

apps.name: Kararead
apps.summary: Read articles from your Karakeep library on Android.
apps.description: An independent Karakeep client with a focused article reader, configurable reading settings and saved lists. Connect it to your existing Karakeep server with an API key.

apps.name: Kirsch
apps.summary: Capture glare-reduced digital copies of printed photographs on Android.
apps.description: Aligns and combines multiple captures on-device, corrects the print's geometry, and exports JPEG or TIFF scans. Restoration options produce separate derivatives rather than replacing the scan.

apps.name: LLimit
apps.summary: Monitor AI subscription quotas in a Mac menu bar, desktop widgets, or Linux status bars.
apps.description: Tracks rolling, weekly and monthly limits across multiple providers and accounts. The Linux daemon and CLI provide modules for waybar, polybar and eww.

apps.name: Lucerne
apps.summary: Write letters and small documents with a ClarisWorks-inspired word processor.
apps.description: A native word processor with rulers, tabs and free image placement. Its .luce files contain an editable document model, original images, a Markdown copy and dated backups.
apps.maturityNote: Described by its author as an experimental word processor.

apps.name: OpenCodeQuota Widget
apps.summary: Show your OpenCode AI account quotas in a Mac desktop widget.
apps.description: A WidgetKit widget and host app that discover configured OpenCode accounts and display their quota usage. Supports several providers and requires macOS 14 or later.

apps.name: Pict
apps.summary: Choose custom app icons shared by Pict, Jetty, Zap and Top Drawer.
apps.description: Pick icons from files, SVGs, themes or an embedded web browser. A shared local icon store lets the companion Mac utilities use the same artwork. Requires macOS 13 or later.

screenshots.alt: Pict choosing an icon from a web page

apps.name: Rememoru
apps.summary: Save and restore Mac window layouts across displays and Spaces.
apps.description: Records window positions, desktops, fullscreen states and Split View pairs, then restores a layout on demand or at login. The menu-bar app also offers a command-line interface. Requires macOS 13 or later.

apps.name: Shortking
apps.summary: Find which Mac apps claim a keyboard shortcut and diagnose who intercepted it.
apps.description: Inventories system and app shortcuts, then uses live capture and diagnostic tests to investigate unexpected hotkey behaviour. It diagnoses shortcuts rather than remapping them. Requires macOS 14 or later.

apps.name: ShrinkPub
apps.summary: Reduce EPUB file sizes by recompressing and resizing embedded images.
apps.description: Drop books into the desktop app or process them with the batch CLI. It writes a smaller sibling file and preserves the original book, retaining each replacement image only when it saves space.

apps.name: Sion
apps.summary: Draw diagrams and illustrations with editable shapes and routed connectors on macOS.
apps.description: Shapes have editable connection points; connectors preview their routed paths. Documents bundle the editable scene, original assets, SVG and Mermaid exports, and retained history. Requires macOS 13 or later.

apps.name: Sortomat
apps.summary: Organize incoming Mac files with folder rules and optional language-model classification.
apps.description: Match files by names, dates, tags and contents, then move them into templated destinations. Optional language-model steps choose from an allowed folder set. Moves are journaled and undoable. Requires macOS 13 or later.

apps.name: Spots
apps.summary: Show sensor-driven motion cues at the screen edges on Android.
apps.description: An on-device overlay whose dots follow vehicle motion, inspired by Vehicle Motion Cues. It uses the phone's motion sensors and has off, on and automatic modes.
apps.maturityNote: An experimental passenger comfort aid, not a medical device.

apps.name: VaultSquire
apps.summary: Access Vaultwarden, Proton Pass and 1Password from a native Mac password-manager client.
apps.description: Vaultwarden supports reading and editing items with an encrypted offline cache. Proton Pass and 1Password use their official command-line clients for read-only access.
apps.maturityNote: A source tree without a supported or distributable release.

apps.name: Zen Backup Manager
apps.summary: Browse and restore saved Zen Browser sessions on macOS.
apps.description: Inspect tabs and Spaces on a timeline of browser-session backups. Restoration saves a verified safety copy and supports undo. Everything stays local. Requires macOS 14 or later.
